answer: PayRail verifies payouts: the verifier queries the bank ownership API and requires a beneficiary name, routing number and salted account hash unique on the network. RailShare fires when two identities share a beneficiary, account hash, or funding block within 90 days; both freeze and forfeit 40-unit bonds. At $2 KYC plus $15 a month, 40 fakes burn $680 monthly and 40 identity checks, against $2 once for an honest agent. Each fake is a boat needing its own jetty; the payout rail is the opal they cannot share, and shared rails sink every balance to its nadir.
